cost.description: The time spent on this transfer.

address.description:
The address of destination database, which to receive the dataset.

  - Database address format:
	  - mysql://[username:[password]@][protocol[(address)]][:port][/dbname][?param1=value1&...]
	  - maria|mariadb://[username:[password]@][protocol[(address)]][:port][/dbname][?param1=value1&...]
	  - postgres|postgresql://[username:[password]@][address][:port][/dbname][?param1=value1&...]
	  - oracle://[username:[password]@][address][:port][/service][?param1=value1&...]
	  - mssql|sqlserver://[username:[password]@][address][:port][/instance][?database=dbname&param1=value1&...]

batch_cap.description: The maximum value statement number for once insert statements.

conn_max.description: The maximum opening connectors of destination database.

salt.description:
The salt assist calculating the destination database has changed 
but the address not, like the database Terraform Managed Resource ID.

address.description:
The address of source, which to provide the dataset, 
choose from local/remote SQL file or database.

  - Local/Remote SQL file format:
	  - file:///path/to/filename
	  - http(s)://...
	  - raw://...
	  - raw+base64://...

  - Database address format:
	  - mysql://[username:[password]@][protocol[(address)]][:port][/dbname][?param1=value1&...]
	  - maria|mariadb://[username:[password]@][protocol[(address)]][:port][/dbname][?param1=value1&...]
	  - postgres|postgresql://[username:[password]@][address][:port][/dbname][?param1=value1&...]
	  - oracle://[username:[password]@][address][:port][/service][?param1=value1&...]
	  - mssql|sqlserver://[username:[password]@][address][:port][/instance][?database=dbname&param1=value1&...]

conn_max.description: The maximum connections of source database.

block.description: Specify the pipeline to seed database.
